question: How many PMAY-G houses were completed in Ri Bhoi?
actual: [data] Completed houses in Ri Bhoi, across all financial years (FY 2017-18 to FY 2023-24): 12,056. This is the PMAY-G figure across all financial years.
sql:
SELECT
  UPPER(lgd_district) AS entity_key,
  MAX(lgd_district) AS name,
  COUNT(*) AS houses,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount), 0) AS sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)), 0) AS released,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS released_on_sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS sanctioned_positive,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_completed) AS completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS incomplete,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name IS NULL) AS no_status,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0 AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS full_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    COALESCE(amount_released, 0) > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) < sanctioned_amount) AS part_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    COALESCE(amount_released, 0) = 0) AS no_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount
    AND NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS full_not_done,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sanction_no) AS sanction_numbers,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_placeholder) AS placeholders,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Completed') AS st_completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Completed'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Roof Cast') AS st_roof_cast,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Roof Cast'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_roof_cast,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Plinth') AS st_plinth,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Plinth'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_plinth,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'House Sanctioned') A

question: How many PMAY-G houses were completed in Ri Bhoi?
actual: [data] Completed houses in Ri Bhoi, across all financial years (FY 2017-18 to FY 2023-24): 12,056. This is the PMAY-G figure across all financial years.
sql:
SELECT
  UPPER(lgd_district) AS entity_key,
  MAX(lgd_district) AS name,
  COUNT(*) AS houses,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount), 0) AS sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)), 0) AS released,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS released_on_sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS sanctioned_positive,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_completed) AS completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS incomplete,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name IS NULL) AS no_status,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0 AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS full_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    COALESCE(amount_released, 0) > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) < sanctioned_amount) AS part_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    COALESCE(amount_released, 0) = 0) AS no_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount
    AND NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS full_not_done,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sanction_no) AS sanction_numbers,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_placeholder) AS placeholders,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Completed') AS st_completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Completed'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Roof Cast') AS st_roof_cast,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Roof Cast'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_roof_cast,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Plinth') AS st_plinth,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Plinth'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_plinth,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'House Sanctioned') A

question: How many PMAY-G houses were completed in Ri Bhoi?
actual: [data] Completed houses in Ri Bhoi, across all financial years (FY 2017-18 to FY 2023-24): 12,056. This is the PMAY-G figure across all financial years.
sql:
SELECT
  UPPER(lgd_district) AS entity_key,
  MAX(lgd_district) AS name,
  COUNT(*) AS houses,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount), 0) AS sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)), 0) AS released,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS released_on_sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS sanctioned_positive,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_completed) AS completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS incomplete,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name IS NULL) AS no_status,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0 AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS full_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    COALESCE(amount_released, 0) > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) < sanctioned_amount) AS part_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    COALESCE(amount_released, 0) = 0) AS no_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount
    AND NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS full_not_done,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sanction_no) AS sanction_numbers,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_placeholder) AS placeholders,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Completed') AS st_completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Completed'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Roof Cast') AS st_roof_cast,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Roof Cast'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_roof_cast,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Plinth') AS st_plinth,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Plinth'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_plinth,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'House Sanctioned') A

question: How many PMAY-G houses were completed in Ri Bhoi?
actual: [data] Completed houses in Ri Bhoi, across all financial years (FY 2017-18 to FY 2023-24): 12,056. This is the PMAY-G figure across all financial years.
sql:
SELECT
  UPPER(lgd_district) AS entity_key,
  MAX(lgd_district) AS name,
  COUNT(*) AS houses,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount), 0) AS sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)), 0) AS released,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS released_on_sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS sanctioned_positive,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_completed) AS completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS incomplete,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name IS NULL) AS no_status,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0 AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS full_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    COALESCE(amount_released, 0) > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) < sanctioned_amount) AS part_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    COALESCE(amount_released, 0) = 0) AS no_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount
    AND NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS full_not_done,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sanction_no) AS sanction_numbers,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_placeholder) AS placeholders,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Completed') AS st_completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Completed'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Roof Cast') AS st_roof_cast,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Roof Cast'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_roof_cast,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Plinth') AS st_plinth,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Plinth'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_plinth,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'House Sanctioned') A

GROUP BY scheme_name, lgd_district
ORDER BY scheme_name, lgd_district
